plugins.name: 90north-develop
plugins.description: North's development plugin: dev-loop (story → design gate → acceptance red → test-first build → review/QA → demo video → PR → review lane), defect-loop (repro → root cause → test-first fix → review/QA → before/after videos → PR → QA lane) and n-loop (unattended: AI queue → triage any card type → spec red → build → spec green → adversarial verifier → ship by policy → learn), on the n-dev discipline, with n-arch capturing each repo's architecture rules, for any repo.
